test("the events feed: tier, kind groups, the catalogue context and the area") {
  def ids(f: Filter = Filter(), kind: Option[String] = None, more: EventSql.Narrow = EventSql.Narrow()) = EventFixtures.list(ds, f, PlaceScope.empty, None, kind, None, None, 500, 0, more).events.map(_.id).filter(i => i.startsWith("zqec") || i.startsWith("zztest")).toSet
  assertEquals(ids(more = EventSql.Narrow(tier = Some("catalogue"))), Set("zztest_b"))
  assertEquals(ids(more = EventSql.Narrow(tier = Some("attested"))), Set("zqec_compiled"))
  assertEquals(ids(kind = Some("natural")), Set("zqec_compiled", "zztest_b"))
  assertEquals(ids(kind = Some("human")), Set.empty[String])
  val bySource = Filter(tags = List("zqec"), period = Some(Period(-2000, -1000)))
  assertEquals(ids(bySource), Set("zqec_compiled"))
  assertEquals(ids(bySource, more = EventSql.Narrow(context = true)), Set("zqec_compiled", "zztest_b"))
  assertEquals(ids(more = EventSql.Narrow(area = BBox.parse("150.5,-41,151.5,-39"))), Set("zztest_b"))
  val geo = EventFixtures.geo(ds, Filter(), PlaceScope.empty, Some("Zqec"), None, None, None, 100, 0.01, EventSql.Narrow(tier = Some("catalogue")))
  assertEquals(geo.events.find(_.id == "zztest_b").map(g => (g.tier, g.size)), Some(("catalogue", Some("VEI 4"))))
}

test("backup → download → drop a source → restore --force → search finds it again") {
  val h = ServerWiring(Deps(cfg, ds))
  assert(h.library.sources.put("zz_backup_a", fixture("zz_backup_a", "The Kept One")).isRight)
  assert(h.library.sources.put("zz_backup_b", fixture("zz_backup_b", "The Other One")).isRight)
  val before = h.library.search.sources(Filter(tags = List("zz-backup-test"), limit = 10)).total
  assertEquals(before, 2)
  supervised {
    val b = Composition.server(cfg, "127.0.0.1", 0).start()
    val url = s"http://127.0.0.1:${
      b.port
    }"
    try {
      val (bs, first) = post(s"$url/api/backup", "")
      assertEquals(bs, 200, first)
      val deadline = System.nanoTime() + 300000000000L
      var bb = first
      while (field(bb, "state") == "running" && System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
        Thread.sleep(500)
        bb = get(s"$url/api/backup/status")._2
      }
      assertEquals(field(bb, "state"), "done", bb)
      val file = field(bb, "file")
      val bytes = number(bb, "bytes")
      val hash = field(bb, "sha256")
      assert(Backup.safeName(file).isRight, file)
      assert(bytes > 0, bb)
      assertEquals(hash.length, 64, bb)
      assertEquals(Files.size(backupDir.resolve(file)), bytes)
      assert(Files.list(backupDir).count() == 1L, "the .part file should have been moved into place")
      val (ls, lb) = get(s"$url/api/backups")
      assertEquals(ls, 200, lb)
      assert(lb.contains(file), lb)
      val dl = http.send(HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(s"$url/api/backups/$file")).build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofByteArray())
      assertEquals(dl.statusCode, 200)
      assertEquals(dl.body.length.toLong, bytes)
      assertEquals(sha256(dl.body), hash)
      assertEquals(get(s"$url/api/backups/histmersion-20200101T000000Z.dump")._1, 404)
      assert(get(s"$url/api/backups/..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd.dump")._1 != 200)
      assert(get(s"$url/api/backups/not-a-dump.txt")._1 != 200)
      val (rs, rb) = post(s"$url/api/restore", s"""{"file":"$file","force":false}""")
      assertEquals(rs, 400, rb)
      assert(rb.contains("force"), rb)
      sql("DELETE FROM sources WHERE citekey = 'zz_backup_a'")
      assert(h.library.sources.get("zz_backup_a").isLeft)
      assertEquals(h.library.search.sources(Filter(tags = List("zz-backup-test"), limit = 10)).total, 1)
      val (fs, fb) = post(s"$url/api/restore", s"""{"file":"$file","force":true}""")
      assertEquals(fs, 200, fb)
      assertEquals(number(fb, "sourcesBefore"), 1L)
      assertEquals(number(fb, "sourcesAfter"), 2L)
      assertEquals(field(fb, "schemaVersion"), Migrate.current(ds).getOrElse("?"))
      com.histmersion.util.database.Db.evict(ds)
      val after = h.library.search.sources(Filter(tags = List("zz-backup-test"), limit = 10))
      assertEquals(after.total, 2)
      assertEquals(after.hits.map(_.source.citekey).sorted, List("zz_backup_a", "zz_backup_b"))
      val got = h.library.sources.get("zz_backup_a").toOption.get
      assertEquals(got.source.title, "The Kept One")
      assertEquals(got.findings.map(_.claim), List("zz_backup_a says something"))
      assertEquals(got.source.periodStart, Some(-1300L))
      assert(h.library.sources.put("zz_backup_c", fixture("zz_backup_c", "After The Restore")).isRight)
    } finally b.stop()
  }
}
